en: Color postcard showing an elevated view over a historic European city square crowded with 1960s–1970s era cars. Dominating the right foreground is a large domed stone building (the Mosque of Pasha Qasim) fronting a circular traffic layout. Behind it are rows of old townhouses and civic buildings, and on the left in the middle distance stands a large cathedral with four tall square towers. The scene is surrounded by hills and scattered houses. The reverse side is a standard divided-back postcard layout with multilingual caption and publisher information in Hungarian, German, English, and Russian.
